input.summary: Limit Teleglobe's O&M Costs commitment to the current 12-month period and make it reducible on 30 days' notice
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot take a 25-year, uncapped O&M funding commitment with no reduction right, so we have limited our O&M Costs commitment under Subparagraph 7.2 to the then-current twelve (12) month period and made it reducible on thirty (30) days' notice. Actual-cost true-up already operates under Subparagraph 7.7.

ops.oldText: 7.2 The O&M Costs as defined in Paragraph 6 shall be borne by the Parties in the proportions set forth in Schedule B.
ops.newText: 7.2 The O&M Costs as defined in Paragraph 6 shall be borne by the Parties in the proportions set forth in Schedule B, provided that Teleglobe USA Inc.'s commitment to bear O&M Costs is limited to the then-current twelve (12) month period and may be reduced by it on thirty (30) days' prior written notice.
